sourceDescription: Two user-approved AI-generated ceremony illustrations developed from the user-supplied JessicaWaterOfLifeCentipedePress.webp painting and Dune Zone's Campfire decal. The supplied filename identifies the reference; the original artist and publication were not independently verified.

approval.scope: The user selected the detailed monochrome bitmap, requested a multicolor version with a red dress, then approved both and requested production publication.
approval.evidence: both approved, add them to prod please

preparation.paletteAssignment: Nearest RGB palette entry. Cleaned alpha supplies the black silhouette; separate red and cream masks preserve the approved flat color areas.
preparation.trace: Potrace 1.16, turdsize 8, alphamax 1.0, opttolerance 0.25. SVG authoring root and provenance steps, uniform square normalization and the decal optimization profile follow tracing.

/vector/decal/water-of-life-ceremony.svg.paint: Inherited from the caller. Internal details remain transparent cutouts.

/vector/decal/water-of-life-ceremony-mul.paint: Three fixed colors from the existing Measured Offering palette. The central dress is muted red.
